items.prompt: What should a useful Greek bump validation report show beyond one matching number?
items.modelAnswer: Model/contract and held-fixed conventions, units/signs, bump sizes and valid endpoints, analytic/independent reference, tolerances, error trend over scales and roundoff/kink limitations. Position multiplier/sign and percent/bp/day conversion must be explicit. Matching does not establish real hedge performance.

criteria.text: Separates local sensitivity from realized outcomes.
